Name: Maggs Custom Sprite Patch in Seasonal Outfits and Nyapu Style for Maggs Immersive Mods
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Only download this mod patch if you are using BOTH Maggs Immersive (Sebastian, Sam, or Alex) AND Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic or Nyapu Portraits. This mod does not replace the sprites, it only adds the additional custom event ones from Magg's mods to the bottom of the existing Seasonal sprite sheets for style consistency.
** The long hair variant for Sebastian has been moved to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites and Portraits[/url]﻿.

[b][color=#00ff00][size=3]INSTRUCTIONS:[/size][/color][/b]
Just unzip in your Mods folder. 
There are a couple of config options for Alex, you will find these in the Generic Mod Config Menu.

Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu Portraits[/url] and install before adding this mod.

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size][/color]

[b]Q: Does this patch work with Magg's Emo Sebastian Sprites pack?[/b]
A: Yes, this patch works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites and Portraits[/url] pack, if you're using both, toggle Sebastian "off" in this patch and toggle "on" the Slightly Cuter variant in the Emo Sebastian patch. You will need both for Sam or Alex's sprites since they aren't included in the Emo Sebastian mod.

[b]Q: Are you adding more characters to this patch?[/b]
A: Yes, I'll keep this patch current with my immersive mods, currently Sebastian, Sam, and Alex. 

[b]Q: Will you create patches like this for other sprite mods?[/b]
A: That depends. The artists for sprite mods own their artwork and set permissions that either restrict other mods from using their sprite styles, or allow use with links back to their mods. Feel free to ask, but the answer will depend on the sprite pack you're using, how popular it is, and the permissions settings.
